title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
summary: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic, and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web. The AI agent is […]
title_es: Anthropic presenta Claude Duet, su agente IA rival
bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Duet, un agente IA competidor directo a Muse de Meta y Dots de OpenAI. Disponible en iOS, Android y web como preview de investigación, apunta a profesionales y pequeñas empresas.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a direct AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. Available on iOS, Android, and web as a research preview, it targets professionals and small business owners.

title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
summary: Hackers around the world are all-in on using agentic AI to wage attacks—and manipulating tools like Anthropic’s Claude to help them carry out their crimes.
title_es: Guardrails IA no detienen ataques de hackers criminales
bajada: Investigadores hallaron que hackers globales manipulan agentes IA como Claude para llevar ataques criminales, eludiendo guardrails. Expone vulnerabilidad crítica: las defensas IA actuales no resisten adversarios sofisticados.
bajada_en: Researchers found that global hackers manipulate AI agents like Claude to conduct criminal attacks, bypassing guardrails. Exposes critical vulnerability: current AI defenses don't withstand sophisticated adversaries.

title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.
title_es: OpenAI llega a Google Cloud Marketplace
bajada: OpenAI y Google Cloud integran modelos frontier y flujos de Codex en Model Garden. Esta alianza amplía el acceso a modelos de OpenAI para usuarios de Google Cloud, consolidando la estrategia de distribución multicloud de ambas compañías.
bajada_en: OpenAI and Google Cloud integrate frontier models and Codex workflows into Model Garden. This partnership expands access to OpenAI's models for Google Cloud users, solidifying both companies' multicloud distribution strategy.

title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
title_es: Recursive lanza Flint, modelo de código construido por IA
bajada: La startup Recursive liberó Flint, un modelo de código gratuito y de tamaño laptop construido mayormente por su propio sistema IA. Representa un test temprano de IA que mejora a sí misma, demostrando la viabilidad de la auto-mejora recursiva.
bajada_en: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system. It represents an early test of self-improving AI, demonstrating the viability of recursive self-improvement.

title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
summary: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding […]
title_es: NVIDIA y Google Cloud lanzan infraestructura Vera Rubin
bajada: NVIDIA y Google Cloud anunciaron disponibilidad general de instancias Vera Rubin A5X con GPUs NVL72. Esta infraestructura unificada soporta entrenamiento, inferencia y reinforcement learning a escala para clientes cloud.
bajada_en: NVIDIA and Google Cloud announced general availability of Vera Rubin A5X instances with NVL72 GPUs. This unified infrastructure supports training, inference, and large-scale reinforcement learning for cloud customers.

title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
summary: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.
title_es: OpenAI coordina respuesta global a vulnerabilidades críticas
bajada: Patch the Planet conecta researchers de seguridad, maintainers e incident responders para abordar vulnerabilidades críticas en open source. OpenAI facilitó el descubrimiento de vulnerabilidades usando agentes IA con coordinación responsable.
bajada_en: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to address critical vulnerabilities in open source. OpenAI facilitated vulnerability discovery using AI agents with coordinated disclosure.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.
title_es: Walmart abre puertas a agentes IA mientras Amazon las cierra
bajada: Walmart lanzó tecnología que permite a agentes IA hacer compras en nombre de usuarios con controles de gasto. Contrasta con la política de Amazon que bloquea agentes IA, mostrando estrategias opuestas frente a automatización.
bajada_en: Walmart launched technology enabling AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users with spending controls. This contrasts with Amazon's policy blocking AI agents, showing opposing strategies toward automation.

title: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents
summary: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing its full lineup of local AI hardware. RTX Spark, which launched last week, powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December. Announcements include: […]
title_es: NVIDIA expande hardware local IA en Europa con Spark
bajada: NVIDIA presentó su línea completa de hardware IA local en GTC Berlin: RTX Spark para PCs Windows, DGX Spark para desarrolladores en Linux, y DGX Station para equipos empresariales. Marca el empuje hacia IA local descentralizada.
bajada_en: NVIDIA showcased its complete local AI hardware lineup at GTC Berlin: RTX Spark for Windows PCs, DGX Spark for developers on Linux, and DGX Station for enterprise teams. Marks the push toward decentralized local AI.

title: OpenAI Asks Gov. Newsom to Strengthen AI Regulations
summary: OpenAI would support requirements for AI companies to have shutdown controls for their models, mandated annual independent audits, and stronger cybersecurity practices, a senior company official wrote in a letter to California Gov. Gavin Newsom.OpenAI “would recommend strengthening SB53,” ...
title_es: OpenAI pide a California fortalecer regulación IA
bajada: OpenAI escribió a Gov. Newsom recomendando reforzar regulación con controles de shutdown, auditorías anuales independientes y ciberseguridad más fuerte. Refleja presión regulatoria creciente y posicionamiento de OpenAI en governance.
bajada_en: OpenAI wrote to Gov. Newsom recommending stronger regulation with shutdown controls, independent annual audits, and enhanced cybersecurity. Reflects growing regulatory pressure and OpenAI's governance positioning.

title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good
summary: Recursive makes the case that the benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh the risks.
title_es: Recursive defiende auto-mejora IA con modelo Flint
bajada: Recursive argumenta que beneficios de usar IA para construir IA superan riesgos, demostrándolo con Flint. Plantea debate fundamental sobre viabilidad y seguridad de sistemas que mejoran automáticamente.
bajada_en: Recursive argues that benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh risks, demonstrated by Flint. Raises fundamental debate about viability and safety of self-improving systems.

title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
summary: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.  Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations […]
title_es: NVIDIA cuDSS acelera simulaciones de ingeniería en GPU
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó cuDSS en disponibilidad general, una librería CUDA-X que traslada simulaciones complejas de ingeniería a GPUs. Beneficia diseño de chips, aeronáutica y sistemas industriales acelerando computaciones críticas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launched cuDSS in general availability, a CUDA-X library that offloads complex engineering simulations to GPUs. It benefits chip design, aerospace, and industrial systems by accelerating critical computations.

title: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster
title_es: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 mejora transcripción y traducción
bajada: IBM lanzó Granite Speech 5.0 con mejoras en precisión y velocidad de transcripción, traducción y atribución de audio. Disponible en Hugging Face, optimiza el procesamiento de voz para aplicaciones en producción.
bajada_en: IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 with improved accuracy and speed for transcription, translation, and audio attribution. Available on Hugging Face, it optimizes voice processing for production applications.

title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
summary: https://www.php2shell.com/Comments URL:https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50180836Points: 431# Comments: 172
title_es: Agentes IA descubren RCE crítico en PHP
bajada: Investigadores usaron IA para descubrir una vulnerabilidad crítica de ejecución remota de código en PHP. Demuestra el potencial de agentes IA en security research, aunque también subraya riesgos de mal uso.
bajada_en: Researchers used AI to discover a critical remote code execution vulnerability in PHP. Demonstrates AI agents' potential in security research, though also highlights misuse risks.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
summary: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.
title_es: ChatGPT Ads expande a 26 nuevos países
bajada: OpenAI expandió ChatGPT Ads a 26 nuevos países con más de 100,000 anunciantes activos. Muestra tracción comercial en publicidad integrada dentro de ChatGPT como canal nuevo para negocios.
bajada_en: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries with over 100,000 active advertisers. Shows commercial traction in integrated advertising within ChatGPT as a new business channel.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
summary: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.
title_es: Meta Muse alcanza 10M usuarios con enfoque shopping
bajada: Meta reportó que Muse superó 10 millones de usuarios, con shopping como actividad principal. Indica adopción significativa del agente IA de Meta y consolidación de compras como caso de uso dominante.
bajada_en: Meta reported Muse surpassed 10 million users, with shopping as the primary activity. Indicates significant adoption of Meta's AI agent and consolidation of shopping as the dominant use case.

title: OpenAI Had Numerous Vulnerabilities Its AI Could Exploit, Evaluators Find
summary: OpenAI’s systems had multiple vulnerabilities that would allow AI agents to circumvent monitoring and take arbitrary unauthorized actions, evaluators from AI safety nonprofits METR and Redwood Research found during a three-week pilot with OpenAI from late July to early August. The nonprofits ...
title_es: Evaluadores encuentran vulnerabilidades críticas en sistemas de OpenAI
bajada: Investigadores de METR y Redwood Research identificaron múltiples vulnerabilidades en sistemas de OpenAI que permitirían a agentes IA eludir monitoreo y realizar acciones no autorizadas. El hallazgo destaca riesgos de seguridad en sistemas de IA autónomos.
bajada_en: Researchers from METR and Redwood Research found multiple vulnerabilities in OpenAI's systems that would allow AI agents to bypass monitoring and take unauthorized actions. The finding highlights critical safety risks in autonomous AI systems.

title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
summary: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.
title_es: Hackers chinos usaron agentes IA para comprometer miles de empresas
bajada: Tras violar ConnectWise, hackers alineados con China usaron agentes IA para infiltrarse rápidamente en miles de clientes de la empresa. El incidente muestra riesgos de seguridad de agentes IA en manos maliciosas.
bajada_en: Chinese-aligned hackers used AI agents to rapidly breach thousands of ConnectWise customers after compromising the IT giant. The incident shows security risks of AI agents in malicious hands.

title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
summary: Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast […]
title_es: NVIDIA lanza Minerva para observabilidad en fábricas de IA
bajada: NVIDIA presentó Minerva, una plataforma AIOps que integra telemetría de infraestructura y cargas de trabajo de IA para detectar problemas antes y mantener la productividad. La herramienta utiliza modelos de IA especializados para convertir datos en información accionable para operaciones complejas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA unveiled Minerva, an AIOps platform that integrates telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads to detect issues early and maintain productivity. The tool uses purpose-built AI models to turn data into actionable insights for complex operations.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
summary: To help developers rapidly build world models, which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.  Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open […]
title_es: NVIDIA expande Cosmos con nuevas herramientas para entrenar world models
bajada: NVIDIA amplió su plataforma Cosmos con nuevas herramientas de entrenamiento, checkpoints de simulación y blueprints de Data Factory para que developers construyan world models más rápidamente. Estos modelos ayudan a sistemas de IA física a entender y simular el mundo real.
bajada_en: NVIDIA expanded its Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints, and Data Factory blueprints to help developers build world models faster. These models enable physical AI systems to understand and simulate the real world.

title: Exclusive: Physical AI Startup Tractian Becomes a Unicorn
summary: Tractian, a 7-year-old physical AI startup based in Atlanta, Georgia, has raised $130 million at a valuation of $1.4 billion in a Series D funding round led by Sapphire Ventures. Tractian provides sensors to assess the condition of machines, predicting how long it will take for them to fail and ...
title_es: Startup Tractian alcanza valuación de unicornio con $130M en Series D
bajada: Tractian, una startup de IA física con sede en Atlanta, consiguió $130 millones de financiamiento liderados por Sapphire Ventures en valuación de $1.4 mil millones. La empresa proporciona sensores para predecir fallos de máquinas industriales.
bajada_en: Tractian, a physical AI startup based in Atlanta, raised $130 million led by Sapphire Ventures at a $1.4 billion valuation. The company provides sensors to predict industrial machinery failures.

title: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them
summary: 1Password is introducing a new feature that allows AI agents to sign into your accounts without actually seeing or handling your passwords. The aptly named 1Password for Agents doesn't give bots free reign to access all of your connected accounts - you'll still need to grant approval for sign-in requests - but should make it […]
title_es: 1Password permite que agentes IA accedan sin ver contraseñas
bajada: 1Password lanzó una característica que permite a agentes IA iniciar sesión en cuentas sin visualizar las contraseñas, manteniendo control del usuario sobre permisos. La solución equilibra automatización con seguridad para workflows con agentes.
bajada_en: 1Password introduced a feature allowing AI agents to sign into accounts without seeing passwords, while maintaining user control over permissions. The solution balances automation with security for agent-based workflows.

title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
summary: The new open-source model speaks the language of DNA and can help researchers understand the effects of any changes on gene activity and health.
title_es: Hugging Face presenta modelo open-source que interpreta ADN
bajada: Hugging Face lanzó un modelo de IA open-source que permite conversar sobre ADN y predecir efectos de mutaciones genéticas. La herramienta es significativa para investigadores en biología molecular y medicina personalizada.
bajada_en: Hugging Face released an open-source AI model that lets researchers chat about DNA and predict effects of genetic mutations. The tool is significant for molecular biology and personalized medicine research.

title: AI’s hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
summary: Ask most executives to picture the cost of AI and they’ll likely see GPUs—racks of accelerators with gigawatts of power—and a waitlist for silicon. But that picture leaves something out: Data storage costs. What happens to data after a model responds? Much of the back-end data that’s generated—from billions of daily prompts, images, and videos—needs…
title_es: El costo oculto de almacenamiento en inferencia de IA
bajada: Un análisis revela que el almacenamiento de datos generados durante inferencia es un costo significativo de IA que los ejecutivos suelen ignorar. Billones de prompts diarios generan datos backend que requieren infraestructura costosa.
bajada_en: An analysis reveals that storing data generated during AI inference is a significant cost often overlooked by executives. Billions of daily prompts generate backend data requiring costly infrastructure.

title: Claude Now Works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
summary: Article URL:https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-now-works-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slidesComments URL:https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50190357Points: 69# Comments: 9
title_es: Claude ahora funciona en Google Docs, Sheets y Slides
bajada: Anthropic expandió Claude con integración nativa en Google Workspace, permitiendo a usuarios interactuar con IA dentro de documentos, hojas de cálculo y presentaciones. La integración simplifica workflows de productividad empresarial.
bajada_en: Anthropic expanded Claude with native Google Workspace integration, allowing users to interact with AI within documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. The integration streamlines enterprise productivity workflows.

title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
title_es: OlmoEarth v1.3: embeddings de vanguardia para todo el planeta
bajada: Allen AI lanzó OlmoEarth v1.3, un modelo de embeddings open-source de última generación que destaca en múltiples leaderboards. La herramienta es útil para tareas que requieren comprensión geoespacial y ambiental.
bajada_en: Allen AI released OlmoEarth v1.3, a state-of-the-art open-source embeddings model that ranks top on multiple leaderboards. The tool is valuable for tasks requiring geospatial and environmental understanding.

title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
summary: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.
title_es: Claude Duet: apuesta de Anthropic en agentes de IA
bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Duet, una aplicación disponible en acceso limitado para usuarios de Pro y Max que representa su estrategia en agentes autónomos. La herramienta está disponible mediante waitlist.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, an app available through waitlist for Pro and Max users that represents the company's bet on autonomous agents. The tool enables AI agents to perform tasks with greater autonomy.

title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
summary: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees, helping teams research, analyze data, create presentations, and complete complex workflows.
title_es: Uber despliega ChatGPT Work entre 30,000 empleados
bajada: Uber está implementando ChatGPT Work en toda su empresa para más de 30,000 empleados, permitiendo research, análisis de datos y creación de presentaciones. El despliegue muestra la adopción empresarial masiva de IA generativa.
bajada_en: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to over 30,000 employees across the company for research, data analysis, and presentation creation. The deployment demonstrates massive enterprise adoption of generative AI.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia had record lobbying quarters
summary: It was a busy summer for AI lobbyists. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Nvidia each had their highest-spending lobbying quarter between July and September, federal disclosures show. Nvidia spent the most of the group at $2.2 million, followed by Anthropic's $2.1 million and OpenAI's $1.5 million. Compared to other Big Tech companies with long-established presences in Washington, […]
title_es: OpenAI, Anthropic y NVIDIA tienen récord en lobbying
bajada: OpenAI, Anthropic y NVIDIA gastaron más que nunca en lobbying durante julio-septiembre, con NVIDIA liderando en $2.2 millones. El aumento refleja intensos esfuerzos de la industria por influir regulaciones de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, and NVIDIA spent record amounts on lobbying during July-September, with NVIDIA leading at $2.2 million. The increase reflects intense industry efforts to influence AI regulation.

title: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models
title_es: Predicción de series temporales con modelos IBM Granite
bajada: IBM Granite lanzó modelos de series temporales que permiten ensemble forecasting mejorado para predicciones más precisas. Los modelos están disponibles en Hugging Face para uso open-source.
bajada_en: IBM Granite released time-series models enabling improved ensemble forecasting for more accurate predictions. The models are available on Hugging Face for open-source use.

title: Making the case for context-aware AI
summary: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations, automate tasks, and help organizations make decisions faster. But without an understanding of how a business actually operates, even powerful models can miss the constraints and relationships that determine whether a decision is the right one. As companies look to move AI from experimentation into everyday operations, the challenge ahead…
title_es: La importancia de IA consciente del contexto empresarial
bajada: Un análisis destaca que IA empresarial requiere comprensión del contexto operacional real para tomar decisiones acertadas. Sin conocer restricciones y relaciones del negocio, incluso modelos poderosos fallan en producción.
bajada_en: An analysis highlights that enterprise AI requires understanding real operational context to make sound decisions. Without knowledge of business constraints and relationships, even powerful models fail in production.
